summary: ansible-sign exit codes: 1 general failure (bad manifest, missing signature or MANIFEST.in), 2 checksum mismatch, 3 signature verification failure (missing public key, wrong keyring, modified manifest), 4 signing failure (private key not found).
questions: What does ansible-sign exit code 2 mean?
ansible-sign exit code 3 signature verification failure
What are the ansible-sign exit codes?

answer_card.title: ansible-sign exit codes
answer_card.answer_md:
- `0`: success
- `1`: general failure (checksum manifest syntax error, signature file missing, `MANIFEST.in` missing when signing)
- `2`: checksum verification failure (a file changed without re-signing)
- `3`: signature verification failure (public key not in keyring, wrong GnuPG home/keyring, manifest modified)
- `4`: signing failure (private key not found, wrong GnuPG home/keyring)
